MEMO FINANCE DEPARTMENT

To: all Ledgerline users Date: 20 December 2010

VAT standard rate changes to 20% on 4 January 2011
Tax code V175-UK will be closed on 3 January 2011.

From 4 January use tax code VAT20-UK for UK suppliers.
Orders already posted keep their old tax.

i

Finance manager
